title: Signal Shelter / シグナルの屋根

metadata.tags:
**Genre/Style:** Industrial sci‑fi anthem × glitchcore rap cadence × cinematic bass design. 96–104 BPM, half‑time drops with occasional double‑time hats. Crunchy distorted subs, metallic percussion, granular stutter edits, orchestral braams as punctuation, cold synth arps, radio‑static transitions.

**Structure:**
Intro (transmission) → Verse 1 (tight, percussive) → Pre (tension lift) → Chorus (massive drop) → Verse 2 (more melodic) → Bridge (silence + choir smear) → Final Chorus (bigger, brighter edge) → Outro (wind + telemetry beeps).

**Vocals:** Punchy spoken/rap lead with selective sung notes on the chorus. Japanese call‑and‑response lines (short, crisp). Background vox: chopped whispers + reversed chant pad. Keep lyrics intelligible; effects as accents.

**Mood:** Threat outside, calm inside. Boundaries as love. Building a roof over the mind.
metadata.prompt:
## INTRO — Transmission Check

*(radio scan, faint beeps)*

—ping—

Channel open.
Filter armed.

息を吸う。

## VERSE 1 — Weather Report

The sky is full of opinions with teeth
cheap thunder, no rain, all grief

They call it “truth” when it’s just a shove
a label tossed like a glove

でもね
名前じゃない

I learned the hard way: storms don’t argue
they just happen—so I started building

## PRE‑CHORUS — Blueprint

*(riser, metallic ticks; heartbeat kick)*

One beam: receipts.
One beam: craft.
One beam: breath.

屋根を作る
ここに

## CHORUS — Signal Shelter

*(drop: massive sub + braam; then half‑time crush)*

I built a **signal shelter**
where the static can’t enter

If it’s not curiosity
if it’s not specificity
if it’s not adoption—

it can’t live in me

シグナルの屋根
守るよ

I built a **signal shelter**
and I’m staying.

## VERSE 2 — Inside the Roof

Quiet isn’t empty—
it’s an engine at idle

The leak was attention
I was paying rent to the idle

Now I choose my inputs
like food, like sleep

証拠だけ
持って帰る

A test that passes.
A thing that runs.
A note that someone can use.

That’s real.

## PRE‑CHORUS 2 — Gate Logic

*(beat strips; arps flicker)*

Confusion gets one question.
Cruelty gets zero.

優しさは
通す

## BRIDGE — Roof in the Rain

*(beat cuts; choir smear; distant scream stretched into pad)*

Let them shout into the wind.

I’m not the wind.

I’m the house I built.

## FINAL CHORUS — Wider Roof

*(drop returns; bigger hats; brighter chord color)*

I built a **signal shelter**
where the static can’t enter

Curiosity—come in.
Specificity—come in.
Adoption—come in.

Everything else—
pass through.

シグナルの屋根
ここに

I built a **signal shelter**
and I’m staying.

## OUTRO — Telemetry

*(wind, soft piano two notes, faint beeps)*

Logged.

息。

Still here.
